list.title: Administrators
list.intro: Accounts with access to the administration. A delegated administrator only manages the entities attached to their account.
list.caption: List of administrators

form.createIntro: The account is created without a password. A single-use activation link, valid 72 hours, is sent by mail to the administrator or shown to you, so that the person can choose their password.

username.label: Username
username.hint: 3 to 64 characters: lowercase letters, digits, dot, hyphen or underscore. It cannot be changed afterwards.

email.label: Email address
email.hint: It receives the quota alerts of the attached entities.

role.label: Role
role.hint: A super administrator manages every entity and every account.

tenants.hint: The delegated administrator only sees and manages these entities.

requireTotp.label: Require two-factor authentication
requireTotp.hint: Recommended. The administrator will have to configure it at the first sign-in and will not be able to disable it.
requireTotp.mailHint: Mandatory for an invitation by mail.

disabled.label: Account disabled
disabled.hint: A disabled account can no longer sign in; its open sessions are closed.

promotion.hint: Only an activated account with two-factor authentication configured can become a super administrator. Its entity assignments are then removed, since a super administrator has access to every entity.
promotion.demoteHint: To demote a super administrator, select the entities to attach to the account.

activationLink.title: Activation link
activationLink.intro: Give this link to {username} so that they can choose their password.
activationLink.shownOnce: This link is shown only once and is not sent by any email. Copy it now.
activationLink.label: Activation link
activationLink.warning: Hand it over through another channel than the usual email (for example in person, by instant messaging or by phone): anyone who gets it can set the password of the account.
activationLink.done: I have handed over the link

leaveConfirm.title: Leave without copying the link?
leaveConfirm.text: You have not copied the activation link. It cannot be shown again: you will have to reset the credentials to get a new one.

reset.confirmText: The password, two-factor authentication and recovery codes of the account are erased, and its sessions are closed. You will receive a new activation link.
reset.done: The credentials of {username} have been reset.

delete.confirmText: The account and its sessions will be permanently deleted. The audit logs keep track of its actions.

ownAccountNote: This is your own account: you cannot delete, disable or demote it, nor reset its credentials. Manage your password and two-factor authentication from the My account page.

errors.lastSuperAdmin: Not possible: this account is the last usable super administrator. Create or promote another super administrator first.
errors.ownAccount: Not possible on your own account: you would lose access to the administration.
errors.notPromotable: This account cannot become a super administrator: it must be activated and have two-factor authentication configured.
errors.accountDisabled: This account is disabled: enable it before resetting its credentials.
errors.conflict: This action is not possible for this account in its current state. Reload the page and try again.

notFound.title: Administrator not found
notFound.text: This administrator account does not exist or has been deleted.

invitation.title: Send a new invitation
invitation.intro: Issue a new activation link for {username}, who has not activated the account yet.
invitation.revokes: The links issued before are revoked and can no longer be used. The new link is valid 72 hours.
invitation.done: A new activation link has been issued for {username}.
invitation.copyOnly: The activation link of a super administrator account is never sent by mail: it will be shown to you so that you can hand it over yourself.

mail.label: Send by mail to the administrator
mail.hint: The link is sent from the system mailbox of the instance and is never shown here.

copy.label: Show the link to copy and hand over myself
copy.hint: The link is shown once. Hand it over through another channel than email.

sent.title: Invitation sent
sent.text: Invitation sent to {email}. The link is valid until {date}.
sent.totp: The administrator must choose a password and enroll two-factor authentication (TOTP) when activating the account.
sent.notShown: For security, the link is not shown and cannot be retrieved. If the mail does not arrive, send the invitation again.

errors.smtpUnavailable: The invitation cannot be sent by mail: the system mail (TT_SYSTEM_SMTP_*) is not configured by the operator of the instance. Choose “Show the link to copy and hand over myself” and submit again.
errors.alreadyActive: This administrator has already activated the account: there is nothing to send.
errors.rateLimited: Too many invitations for this account. Try again later.
errors.rateLimitedIn: Too many invitations for this account. Try again in {delay}.
errors.conflict: This account cannot receive an invitation in its current state (disabled or already activated). Reload the page.
